heading: Admission defined.
text: An admission is a statement, [1][oral or documentary or contained in electronic form], which suggests any inference as to any fact in issue or relevant fact, and which is made by any of the persons, and under the circumstances, hereinafter mentioned.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by Act 21 of 2000, s. 92 and Second Schedule, for “oral or documentary,” (w.e.f. 17-10-2000).
